propositions: Implement a scoped finite-pass fuse that opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes across at least two tickets per endpoint.
Provider-scoped fuse additionally requires failing outcomes to span at least two distinct endpoints of the same provider.
Eligible outcomes are determined by budget exhaustion provenance (plan_next_retry action=exhausted or defer at cap), never by disposition value or physical attempt count.
Reset consecutive state counter on matching success; independent scopes retain independent state and continue execution.
When open, return explicit scope, reason, and retry_not_before metadata without executing matching remaining plans.
Exclude commit_unknown, recovered, already_satisfied, permanent_failure, ticket-local 404, and replay=True outcomes from counter increment.
